function.name: mon_release
function.what: Releases a party Pokemon. The release is deferred: it is applied at the first player step on the field after the battle. The Pokemon is found by its personality value, so switching or compaction cannot hit the wrong one. It has no effect if it would leave no Pokemon that is not an egg. The party compacts and the next member becomes the lead.
function.wasm: eidos.mon_release(handle, place, side, box, slot) -> i32

recipe.title: Release a Pokemon when it faints
recipe.goal: A fainted Pokemon of the player is released for good (a Nuzlocke rule).
steps: `battle.faint` fires when a Pokemon faints. `event.side` is 0 for the player's side and `event.mon` is the fainted Pokemon.
`mon_release` queues the release. It is applied at the first player step on the field after the battle, so the battle is not disturbed.
It does nothing if the Pokemon is the last one that is not an egg.
recipe.rule:
language 1
rule nuzlocke on battle.faint
    when event.side == 0
    do release event.mon
notes: Whiteout is a separate event, `whiteout`. Poison on the field does not faint a Pokemon in this game.
